title: GTA 6 Just Survived A Massive Last-Minute Ban Threat

lines.text: GTA 6 is facing a massive moral panic right before launch.
lines.label: GTA 6 PANIC

lines.text: Every single mainline entry in the series has sparked outrage.
lines.label: DECADES OF OUTRAGE
lines.subject: Vice City

lines.text: Back in 2001, GTA 3 drew headlines for letting players hire and kill sex workers.
lines.label: 2001 CONTROVERSY

lines.text: And in 2005, the infamous Hot Coffee mod triggered class-action lawsuits.
lines.label: HOT COFFEE MOD

lines.text: Just last week, South Korea's ratings board nearly refused GTA 6 a rating.
lines.label: KOREA RATINGS VOTE
lines.subject: Jason And Lucia

lines.text: The board came within a deadlocked vote over nonsexual nudity in the game.
lines.label: NUDITY DEBATE
lines.ai_prompt: board members looking at video game age rating documents

lines.text: PC Gamer reports that Rockstar draws a clear line between depicting and endorsing violence.
lines.label: ROCKSTAR DEFENSE

lines.text: US courts have repeatedly sided with that argument for years.
lines.label: US COURTS SIDED

lines.text: And then came the final vote.
lines.label: FINAL VOTE

lines.text: South Korea eventually cleared GTA 6 with an Adults Only rating.
lines.label: CLEARED ADULTS ONLY
lines.subject: Vice City

lines.text: GTA 6 has also survived fears of Japanese censorship.
lines.label: JAPAN CENSORSHIP
lines.subject: Lucia Caminos

lines.text: Scares about bans in the Gulf states and the UK also came and went.
lines.label: GLOBAL BANS AVOIDED

lines.text: Newzoo reports that the game carries a bullish sales forecast ahead of its launch.
lines.label: BULLISH SALES FORECAST

lines.text: Will any controversy actually slow down Rockstar's biggest release ever?
lines.label: BIGGEST RELEASE EVER
lines.subject: Jason Duval

description: GTA 6 faces last-minute ratings battles and moral panics ahead of its launch, mirroring decades of controversy for Rockstar Games.
